$comment: no $schema key on purpose: the claude CLI's --json-schema validator (measured 2026-09-15, live fire) refuses a draft/2020-12 $schema ref — 'no schema with key or ref'; the shape is draft-07-compatible and validate() mirrors it by hand
title: rehearsal build tree
description: One cold read of a ticket by the cheapest reader, as a build simulator (ticket c9897770efe6). Each node is one plan step: it builds, or it stopped and names what is missing; stopped is a legal answer. The identity fields (ticket, ticket_sha256, read) are stamped from truth by the machine after the shape is checked, never trusted from the reader.

step.description: the ticket decision this step builds, by id: D<n> (the n of an entry in the ticket's decisions list) — or 'unlisted: <text>' for a step no decision covers, which is itself a gap the ticket owes a decision for

missing.description: empty when the step builds; when stopped, exactly what the plan does not give: the fact, file, name or choice the builder got stopped on
